results.detail: [1] matches the SQL at DTSX:6076: gen_currentstate = 1, ee.CreatedOn >= GETDATE()-7, ID match via SUBSTRING/PATINDEX('%[^0 ]%') on both sides, fm.Gen_existinfile = 1, gen_employerdepositdate <= fm.Gen_FundCreationDate, product pairs 1-1/4-2/2-3, INNER JOIN product and INNER JOIN Account on ee.gen_employersnumber = a.AccountId. The WHERE uses gen_currentstate unqualified. Its attribution to ee is proven by the same query: ee.gen_currentstate is in the SELECT list, so ee has the column, and any second owner among fm/p/a/e would make the query ambiguous. gen_employerdepositdate is quoted unqualified, so no ownership is claimed. [2] LEFT JOIN Gen_employers on e.Gen_employersId = fm.gen_employernumber and a.AccountNumber = e.Gen_CorporateNumber. There is no existing-email lookup and no write-back flag. [3] Check If To Send Mail main.cs:117-141: the false/1 branch needs eemployersId == fmemployernumber (both non-null) and gen_incorrectamount not null; the true/2 branch needs gen_incorrectamount not null; the else branch goes to Errors -> Adding Error message 1 -> ETL Warning 1 2 1; NULL producttype/fundestateid rows are dropped. Send Email main.cs:86-95: deposit type 1 sends to Gvia and 2 to Maasikim. [4] SendMailToMaasikim(…, Guid to, Guid from): type 1 is called with (Gvia, Maasikim) and type 2 with (Maasikim, Maasikim). So from = Maasikim always, and to = Gvia for 1 and Maasikim for 2 (main.cs:89, 94, 126). Subject and body text match main.cs:176-195 (the subject also has a trailing space, which is immaterial). directioncode=true; SendEmail with EmailId, TrackingToken '', IssueSend=true (main.cs:161-174). Get Variables: SELECT gen_key, gen_Value FROM gen_etlvariable where gen_scope='global' or gen_scope = ? with Parameter0 = System::PackageName (DTSX:2394-2403). ReadWrite = GviaQueueId, MaasikimQueueId, OrganizationName, ServerName (DTSX:3283), with empty defaults (DTSX:20-25). OrdinalIgnoreCase dictionary, Add at ProcessInputRow, PostExecute throws on a missing key. Chain Get Variables -> Create ETL -> Send Email -> End is all Success (DTSX:7458-7460), and there are no event handlers. The only CRM writes are email Create plus SendEmail, and framework gen_etlprocess/gen_etlprocesswarning. Nothing updates gen_employerenrolment. [5] Meanings are labelled השערה; delivery is stated as unknown. Plumbing note, not counted: in Send Email To Maasikim a non-'token' SoapException sets ErrorMessage but never calls DirectRowToError (main.cs:99-108), so that row is dropped without a warning.
